sloka: जनः स सुमहांस्त्रस्तो बालवृद्धसमाकुलः ।ददर्श मैथिलीं तत्र प्रविशन्तीं हुताशनम् ।। ६.११९.२९ ।।
transliteration: janaḥ sa sumahāṁstrasto bālavṛddhasamākulaḥ ।dadarśa maithilīṁ tatra praviśantīṁ hutāśanam ।। 6.119.29 ।।

translations.english: Having spoken in that way, Vaidehi went round fire fearlessly, absorbed with in herself and entered the flaming and burning fire.
